```{r}
library(tidyverse)
source("config.R")
```

## User inputs

Update these values for the plate being checked.

```{r}
plate <- "Plates/Nitrite/MMDDYYYY_nitrite_1.csv"
use_high_range <- FALSE
rows_to_drop <- integer(0)
```

```{r}
data <- read.csv(plate, check.names = FALSE)
if ("X" %in% names(data)) data$X <- NULL
conc_vector <- if (use_high_range) N_HIGH else N_LOW

standards_clean <- data %>%
  select(1:3) %>%
  setNames(c("Rep_1", "Rep_2", "Rep_3")) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric),
         Standard_Level = row_number(),
         Concentration = conc_vector[Standard_Level],
         Flagged = Standard_Level %in% rows_to_drop) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Rep_1, Rep_2, Rep_3),
               names_to = "Replication",
               values_to = "Absorbance") %>%
  drop_na(Absorbance)

standards_for_model <- filter(standards_clean, !Flagged)
fit <- lm(Absorbance ~ Concentration, data = standards_for_model)
r2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared

cat("Range:", if (use_high_range) "high" else "low", "\n")
cat("R-squared:", round(r2, 5), "\n")

if (r2 < MIN_R2 && STOP_IF_LOW_R2) {
  stop("Calibration R-squared is below the configured threshold.")
}
```

```{r}
ggplot(standards_clean, aes(Concentration, Absorbance)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Flagged)) +
  geom_smooth(
    data = standards_for_model,
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Calibration curve",
    subtitle = paste("R-squared =", round(r2, 4)),
    x = "Concentration",
    y = "Absorbance"
  )
```
